'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Brian Herold DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Brian Herold AKA House Speaker John Boner
* '''Deck name:''' I'll Have What Xizor's Having
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
